description: This Java source file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView used for displaying log data received via the LogNode interface. It includes methods for formatting and displaying log entries, handling different log levels, exceptions, and chaining log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, formats log messages, and displays them in the view.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data including priority, tag, message, and throwable, then updates the TextView to display the log line. It also passes the log entry to the next LogNode in the chain if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a log string as a new line in the LogView.
